certainty_load_specialization_probe: first 8 deterministic validation batches, full reference model
maturity_probe: first validation batch per layer, exactly as historical implementation; not silently expanded to all eight
specialization: token-ID/expert mutual information; normalized by log(experts) for developmental vector
exposure: sum of historical logged train assignment counts at step 1 and every 25 steps, averaged over layers/experts; NOT complete cumulative accepted updates
distance_normalization: Equal-weight root mean square of feature differences divided by historical 8E/12E pooled feature ranges. Frozen historical ranges preserve the prior coordinate system.
